steps: Inventory heritage assets for digital cult assessment & diagnostics using UNESCO criteria and condition assessment
Prioritize conservation using risk-based approach with climate vulnerability analysis
Design preservation plan with conservation standards and adaptive reuse guidelines
Implement with professional conservation, community stewardship, and legal protection
Monitor condition through periodic inspection and community reporting systems
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — heritage site preservation rate using heritage condition assessment. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — heritage site preservation rate measured annually. Target: 90% sites in good condition. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against UNESCO World Heritage monitoring. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — heritage site preservation rate trending toward 95% good condition. Escalate if <80% condition floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using UNESCO WHC Operational Guidelines. Report to Heritage Preservation Dir..
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a film and media arts industry specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 30 days.
